programme.title: #IkLome / #LIKEME
programme.desc: A few weeks have passed and Caro has slowly but surely found the way at her new school. Yemi and Kyona have become two good friends, but there is something that Caro still withholds for everyone, namely that her mom is seriously ill. On the basis of her poetry assignment for the Dutch lesson, she tries to inform her class of the situation at home. Unfortunately, her poem is not taken seriously by everyone and Caro is running it. / Een aantal weken zijn verstreken en Caro heeft langzaam maar zeker de weg op haar nieuwe school gevonden. Yemi en Kyona zijn twee goeie vrienden geworden, maar er is iets dat Caro desondanks nog steeds voor iedereen achterhoudt, nl. dat haar mama ernstig ziek is. Aan de hand van haar poëzieopdracht voor de les Nederlands probeert ze haar klas op de hoogte te brengen van de situatie thuis. Helaas wordt haar gedicht niet door iedereen serieus genomen en zet Caro het op een lopen.

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pupils whose school has been destroyed come temporarily to take lessons on the Brol. This against the will of Pedro who thinks the brol is already full. According to him, there is no room for the newcomers and Pedro accuses them that they want to take over the school and impose their laws. Soekie stands up for the newcomers and refers the lies of Pedro. / Leerlingen wiens school verwoest is, komen tijdelijk les volgen op het BROL. Dit tegen de zin van Pedro die vindt dat het BROL al vol is. Er is volgens hem geen plaats voor de nieuwelingen en Pedro beschuldigt hen dat ze de school willen overnemen en hun wetten opleggen. Soekie komt op voor de nieuwelingen en weerlegt de leugens van Pedro.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: When Arno has spent unsolicited money from his dad, he is punished by Jackie and Geert. To avoid his sentence, he sets up his own country: Arnoland. There he does not have to follow the rules of the hoppers and can do his way. Daria thinks it is a stupid idea until she discovers the benefits. This way they can watch their favorite horror series and eat as many chips as they want. Jackie is determined not to just let Arno and Daria get away with this. / Wanneer Arno weer eens ongevraagd geld van zijn pa heeft uitgegeven, wordt hij gestraft door Jackie en Geert. Om zijn straf te ontlopen, richt hij zijn eigen land op: Arnoland. Daar hoeft hij de regels van de Hoppers niet te volgen en kan hij zijn zin doen. Daria vindt het een stom idee, tot ze de voordelen ontdekt. Zo kunnen ze naar hun favoriete horrorreeks kijken en zoveel chips eten als ze maar willen. Jackie is vastberaden om Arno en Daria hier niet zomaar mee weg te laten komen.

programme.title: Taking care of Mama / Zorgen voor mama
programme.desc: Kristel is on the road for the fourth year in a row with coach Joost. They are introduced to Wendy and David in Rieme. Their family lives in poverty and misery, is in collective debt scheme and does not get out of the pit. In Bruges, Kristel meets Amber: 18 years and for months roof and homeless. She sleeps on squares, benches, in the bicycle shed or as a sofasurfer with friends. She has no address, no income and no work. A vicious circle. Fatih wants toy to disgrace that tangle and to give Amber shelter a first step. Deborah is the new family coach of caring for Mama. She is an experience expert and social worker. She goes with Kristel to Kessel-Lo to support young single Mama Annelie. For Kristel the start of a special process because Annelie is the daughter of Karina, a mom from the first series. The generation poverty has struck hard within the family. / Kristel is voor het vierde jaar op rij op pad met coach Joost. Ze maken in Rieme kennis met Wendy en David. Hun gezin leeft in armoede en ellende, zit in collectieve schuldenregeling en raakt maar niet uit de put. In Brugge ontmoet Kristel Amber: 18 jaar en al maanden dak- en thuisloos. Ze slaapt op pleinen, bankjes, in de fietsenstalling of als sofasurfer bij vrienden. Ze heeft geen adres, geen inkomen en geen werk. Een vicieuze cirkel. Fatih wil dat kluwen ontwarren en Amber onderdak bezorgen, een eerste stap. Deborah is de nieuwe gezinscoach van Zorgen voor mama. Ze is ervaringsdeskundige en sociaal werker. Ze trekt met Kristel naar Kessel-Lo om jonge alleenstaande mama Annelie te ondersteunen. Voor Kristel de start van een bijzonder traject want Annelie is de dochter van Karina, een mama uit de eerste reeks. De generatiearmoede heeft hard toegeslagen binnen het gezin.

programme.title: More people in their thirties / Dertigers

Voor Taiwan misschien voorgoed verdwijnt, haast Tom zich om het Aziatische eiland alsnog te leren kennen. En dat brengt hem op enkele heel vreemde plekken. Will this be fine again? / In de school heerst er een nieuwe hype: skaten. Daria vindt skaten superstom en wil er niks mee te maken hebben. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.title: A nation witness / Narod priča
programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. In a combination of sincere stories of those who live on their work, through the discovery of the sights and natural beauties of our country and their homes, with the words of hope and inspiration, and with pictures of which the heart is melted, with a cheerfulness that defeats all obstacles and problems, Biljana Stokic will peek into their everyday life. How does an ordinary man live? What are his problems and challenges? What is the strength to work and nurture tradition and good interpersonal relationships? How does our native lump breathe and does she have a flat in her beauty? What do they remember? What are they stunned before? What are they coming back? In front of our camera, they will open up and tell the story, who we do not know how much they carry love, research, courage in themselves, those who know how strangely difficult and easy life is, those who have felt the suffering and beauty of life's simplicity. / Novi format, autorska putopisno-reportažna emisija novinarke Biljane Stokić, otkriće vam šta srce naroda priča o Srpskoj, o tradiciji i istoriji naših gradova i sela, o njihovoj svakodnevici i borbi za očuvanje pravih vrijednosti, marljivom radu, vjeri, i ljubavi prema njihovoj i našoj, otadžbini. U spletu iskrenih priča onih koji žive od svog rada, kroz otkrivanje znamenitosti i prirodnih ljepota naše zemlje i njihovih domova, uz riječi nade i inspiracije, te uz slike od kojih se rastopi srce, sa vedrinom koja porazi sve prepreke i probleme, Biljana Stokić će, dugogodišnjim novinarskim iskustvom, zaviriti u njihovu svakodnevicu. Kako živi običan čovjek? Koji su njegovi problemi i izazovi? U čemu nalazi snagu za radom i njegovanje tradicije i dobrih međuljudskih odnosa? Kako diše naša rodna gruda i ima li joj u ljepoti ravne? Čega se sjećaju? Pred čim ostaju zadivljeni? Čemu se vraćaju? Pred našom kamerom, otvoriće se i ispričati priču, oni za koje ne znamo koliko u sebi nose ljubavi, istrajnosti, hrabrosti, oni koji znaju koliko je život čudnovato težak i lak, oni koji su osjetili i stradanje i ljepotu životne jednostavnosti.

Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

programme.title: From morning to tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the camera of your favorite TV steam, Roe deer and Mark. The two of them except the couple are in the studio, they are for years and private life. However, what the audience doesn't even want, is that their idyll on the screen has nothing to do with what the cameras turn off - the two of them actually live a nightmare. When the Marko director of Television is quitting, to move to competing television, he gets a blow from which he falls into a coma, and the director finds a double, young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play an Oscar brand, and will it work? In addition to being in an interesting way, with many laughs and life situations, their relationship and relationships with colleagues and friends, even to the vortex of the media, will see many secrets, and those business and new love and friendship, and start new avalanches of rivalry. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.desc: The six -part documentary series exploring the history of the cult, globally significant role of the Pope, one of the most respected and most beloved figures. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. programme.title: Football: Championship: 4 round: Milwol - Rexum / Футбол: Чемпиъншип: 4 кръг: Милуол - Рексъм
programme.desc: Championship is the second level in English football. It consists of 24 teams. The first two teams in the final standings enter the Premier League directly, the other teams to sixth place play a playoff. programme.title: Doctor / Doktorice
programme.desc: MATERNAL - (E05, feature series, England, 2023) A series on a humorous, warm and original way shows the problems that employed mothers face. Through a series of funny and moving situations, we gradually find out more about the lives of three doctors who return to work after maternity leave and pandemic. Maryam, Catherine and Helen thought I could have everything - both children and successful careers in healthcare. But no one told them that after the birth of a child, nothing was the same as before. The mind, body, career and relationships change in unimaginable ways, and everyone expects women to simply accept it. For these three friends, who seek to reconcile numerous business and private obligations, life is a daily struggle, but at least they have each other. Dedicated to all women, mothers and health workers all over the world, the series offers a unique insight into the lives of people who maintain our overloaded health systems alive and unbreakable connections that bind them. R .: Rebecca Gatward Ul.: Parmander Note (Dr. Maryam Afidi), Lara Pulver (MS Catherine Macdiarmid), Lisa McGillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Asifa Ahmad (Mosque Goer), Tareq al-Yeddal (Callum) ... / Maternal - (E05, igrana serija, Engleska, 2023) Serija na duhovit, topao i originalan način prikazuje probleme s kojima se suočavaju zaposlene majke. Kroz niz smiješnih i dirljivih situacija postupno doznajemo više o životima triju liječnica koje se nakon rodiljnog dopusta i pandemije vraćaju na posao. Maryam, Catherine i Helen mislile su da mogu imati sve - i djecu i uspješne karijere u zdravstvu. No nitko im nije rekao da nakon rođenja djeteta više ništa nije isto kao prije. Um, tijelo, karijera i odnosi mijenjaju se na nezamislive načine, a svi očekuju da žene jednostavno to prihvate. Za ove tri prijateljice, koje nastoje uskladiti brojne poslovne i privatne obveze, život je svakodnevna borba, no barem imaju jedna drugu. Posvećena svim ženama, majkama i zdravstvenim radnicama u cijelome svijetu, serija nudi jedinstveni uvid u živote ljudi koji održavaju naše preopterećene zdravstvene sustave na životu i neraskidive spone koje ih vežu. R.: Rebecca Gatward Ul.: Parminder Nagra (Dr. Maryam Afridi), Lara Pulver (Ms Catherine MacDiarmid), Lisa McGrillis (Dr. Helen Cavendish), Asifa Ahmad (Mosque Goer), Tareq Al-Jeddal (Callum)...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E15, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E15, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: TRUTH AND LIES - (E02, Educational Program, England, 2023) History of humanity is the history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E02, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2023) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E15, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble property of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E15, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E07, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E07, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E16, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E16, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Truth and lies / Istina i laži
programme.desc: Truth and Lies - (E03, Educational Program, England, 2022) History of humanity is a history of truth and lies. Since ancient times until today, people have used lies to achieve economic, political and personal goals. This battle is run by pencil, keyboard and camera, but also weapons, torture and terror. And continues to relate countless victims. Because, who knows how to use the latest technologies most often can also gain interpretative sovereignty over what the truth is. The six -part documentary series shows that lies have been written history from an international perspective. Through various themes, it illuminates the role of the media in a merciless struggle for the truth. Truth and fabrication are nowhere as close as in religion. Secular interests are carried out under the guise of faith. In the war, lies justify bloodshed and conceal their own motives. Conspiracy theories are used for the outrage of the enemy and the creation of a grandmother. Money plays a special role because it often decides which truth will overcome. When the lies of powerful float to the light of day, scandals are created that not only stir up society, but can also become an incentive for social changes. But there will always be influential, powerful people who shape public opinions and who try to spread their own truth with all means ... / Truth and Lies - (E03, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Povijest čovječanstva povijest je i borbe istine i laži. Od davnina sve do danas ljudi su se služili lažima kako bi postigli ekonomske, političke i osobne ciljeve. Ta se bitka vodi olovkom, tipkovnicom i kamerom, ali i oružjem, mučenjem i terorom. I nastavlja odnositi bezbrojne žrtve. Jer, onaj tko zna kako se najvještije koristiti najnovijim tehnologijama, može steći i interpretativni suverenitet nad onim što istina jest. Šestodijelna dokumentarna serija prikazuje kako se lažima pisala povijest iz međunarodne perspektive. Kroz različite teme osvjetljava ulogu medija u bespoštednoj borbi za istinu. Istina i izmišljotina nigdje nisu tako bliske kao u religiji. Svjetovni se interesi provode pod krinkom vjere. U ratu se lažima opravdava krvoproliće i prikrivaju vlastiti motivi. Teorije urote rabe se za ocrnjivanje neprijatelja i stvaranje babaroge. Novac ima posebnu ulogu jer često odlučuje koja će istina prevladati. Kada laži moćnih isplivaju na svjetlo dana, nastaju skandali koji ne samo da uzburkaju društvo, već mogu postati i poticaj za društvene promjene. No uvijek će biti utjecajnih, moćnih ljudi koji oblikuju javna mišljenja i koji pokušavaju širiti vlastitu istinu svim sredstvima...

programme.title: The promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E16, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E16, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2025) The show was filmed in Sarajevo at the Bookstan Literary Festival. How to write songs about life and death in Gaza, Palestinian poet Mosab Abu Toha explained to us, Alexander Hemon presented a new novel Beituran and Rose and performed with renowned musician Damir Imamovic, and Zoran Predin held a concert, but also promoted the novel The Immaculate. Andrej Blatnik brought us back to us at the time of youth and tumultuous political events through the conversation about the book of Liberation Square, and Dusan Sarotar brought to the stellar map near his ancestors, Prekomurje Jews. It is just part of the conversation we recorded on Bookstan, whose topic this year's theme borrowed the title from the famous song: Zarjavela TroBente ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Emisija je snimljena u Sarajevu na književnom festivalu Bookstan. Kako o životu i smrti u Gazi pisati pjesme, objasnio nam je palestinski pjesnik Mosab Abu Toha, Aleksandar Hemon predstavio je novi roman Bejturan i ruža i nastupio s poznatim glazbenikom Damirom Imamovićem, a Zoran Predin je održao koncert, ali i promovirao roman Bezgrešna. Andrej Blatnik vratio nas je u doba mladosti i burnih političkih događaja kroz razgovor o knjizi Trg oslobođenja a Dušan Šarotar je u Zvjezdanoj karti oživio kraj svojih predaka, prekomurskih Židova. To je samo dio razgovora koje smo snimili na Bookstanu, čija je ovogodišnja tema naslov posudila od poznate pjesme: Zarjavele trobente...

The Doñana National Park in Andalusia is a natural area of ​​the largest biodiversity in Europe. In it, more than three hundred bird species inhabit in the territory that is an important strategic point on their migration routes. Nacionalni park Doñana u Andaluziji prirodno je područje najveće bioraznolikosti u Europi. programme.desc: Graffiti - (E05, Doc. Film, Croatia, 2025) In the fifth episode, we explore why people need artistic expression in public and in which all ways are manifested in the modern world. Vikings left their signatures in the Middle Ages even in Aja Sofia. One of the oldest groups of drawings in this part of Europe is in Istria. Through Romuald's cave, we are led by archeologist Maja Čuk, who shows us drawings between 17,000 and 30,000 years old. This instinct for drawing in public still appears today, which is best seen in children. In Berlin, the curator of the Urban Nation Museum, Michelle Houston, represents exhibition graphics and other artist artists in the context of high art. Explains how the artistic works are valued and priced. Fineness in public can also serve for rehabilitation. Thus, in hospitals and prisons for several years, the paintings of the murals have been organized under strictly controlled conditions. The Zagreb Clinical Hospital Center has more than a hundred murals on its walls, whose painting and performance was organized by Dr. Sc. Melinda Sefcic. In addition to performing the painting actions of the murals, it also explores the influence of murals on patients in hospitals and protégés in penitentiary. In Tokyo, we visit one of the technologically most sophisticated museums of fine arts and talk to a member of the collective who made the Teamlab Takashi Museum. The Zagreb first graders, however, remind us how many arts and even cartoon on the wall can be innocent and honest. Through all these trips, conversations, workshops and research, we are led by the presenter Luka Tokić, who, like most of us, is just a citizen who wants to find out why someone would have HT ... / Grafiti - (E05, dok. film, Hrvatska, 2025) U petoj epizodi istražujemo zašto ljudi imaju potrebu likovnog izražavanja u javnosti i na koje se to sve načine manifestira u suvremenom svijetu. Kroz cijelu povijest ljudskog postojanja zabilježeni su nacrtani crteži ili urezane riječi na javnim površinama. Rimski gradovi bili su prošarani raznim parolama urezanim u kamenim kojim su građeni. Vikinzi su u srednjem vijeku ostavili svoje potpise čak i u Aji Sofiji. Jedna od najstarijih skupina crteža u ovom dijelu Europe nalazi se u Istri. Kroz Romualdovu pećinu vodi nas arheologinja Maja Čuka koja nam pokazuje crteže stare između 17.000 i 30.000 godina. Taj se instinkt za crtanjem u javnosti pojavljuje i danas, što se najbolje vidi kod djece. U Osnovnoj školi Gustava Krkleca grafiti entuzijastkinja Antonija Bačić drži radionicu za učenike prvog razreda. Kako je za očekivati, prvašići su oduševljeni. U Berlinu kustosica muzeja Urban Nation, Michelle Houston, predstavlja izloške grafitera i drugih likovnih umjetnika u kontekstu visoke umjetnosti. Objašnjava na koji se način vrednuju i cijene umjetnička djela. Likovnost u javnosti može služiti i za rehabilitaciju. Tako se u bolnicama i zatvorima već nekoliko godina organiziraju slikanja murala u strogo kontroliranim uvjetima. Klinički bolnički centar Zagreb na svojim zidovima ima više od stotinu murala čije je slikanje i izvedbu organizirala dr. sc. Melinda Šefčić. Osim što provodi akcije slikanja murala, ona istražuje i utjecaj murala na pacijente u bolnicama i štićenike u kaznionicama. U Tokyju posjećujemo jedan od tehnološki najsofisticiranijih muzeja likovne umjetnosti i razgovaramo s članom kolektiva koji je napravio muzej TeamLab Takashijem Kudom. Zagrebački prvašići nas pak podsjećaju koliko umjetnost, pa čak i crtana na zidu, može biti nevina i iskrena. Kroz sva ova putovanja, razgovore, radionice i istraživanja vodi nas voditelj Luka Tokić koji je, kao i većina nas, samo građanin koji želi saznati zašto bi netko ht...

programme.desc: The movie was Krešo - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2024) The intimate portrait of Kreša Golika was told through the memories of the closest, family, friends and associates. Od nastanka antologijskih filmova i serija, (umalo tragičnog kraja snimanja "Tko pjeva, zlo ne misli"), neobične ljubavne priče Leandre i Kreše, do toga kako ga je glasovita Barbra Streisand zvala u Hollywood! programme.title: Endeavour - Young Morse / Endeavour - Mladi Morse
programme.desc: Endeavour - (S03, E03, feature series, England, 2016) In the beginning of June 1967. It turns out that the disappeared Dutch home helper Ingrid Hjort is not a routine investigation as it seemed at first, but pulls endeavors into the competitive world of the Oxford Scientific Community, the Great City Parks, Vecernje Schools. The dignified estate of the Mortmaigne Crevecouer family and the destroyed family with two sisters and brother, each with their own private demons, but united them with a common sense of loss and suspicion of deeper wounds associated with the investigation. When a connection between Ingrid's disappearance and a similar unresolved case of several years ago is detected, it seems that unconventional methods in the investigation will cross the boundaries of police professionalism. Tensioned relationships at the station lead to unexpected conflicts and complicate the matter even more. As the victims are piling up, and the night teenage party on the river is over tragically, Endeavour concludes that in the game of dark forces that they are governing the events of the distance. Thus, Oxford police have found themselves in a tangled club lies and fraud that will threaten them all. R.: Lawrence Gough Ul.: Shaun Evans (DC Endeavour Morse), Roger Allam (di Fred Thursday), Anton Lesser (Chief Superintendent Reginald Bright), Sean Rigby (DS Jim Stanges), Dakota Blue Richards (WPC Shirley Trewlove) ... / Endeavour - (S03, E03, igrana serija, Engleska, 2016) Početak lipnja 1967. Ispostavlja se da slučaj nestale nizozemske kućne pomoćnice Ingrid Hjort nije rutinska istraga kao što se u prvi tren činilo, već vuče Endeavoura u natjecateljski svijet oksfordske znanstvene zajednice, velike gradske parkove, večernje škole i divlju prirodu u okolici grada. Dostojanstveno imanje obitelji Mortmaigne Crevecouer i razorena obitelj s dvije sestre i bratom, od kojih svatko ima svoje privatne demone, ali ujedinjuje ih zajednički osjećaj gubitka i slutnja dubljih rana povezanih s istragom. Kad se otkrije veza između Ingridinog nestanka i sličnog neriješenog slučaja od prije nekoliko godina, čini se da će nekonvencionalne metode u istrazi prijeći granice policijske profesionalnosti. Napeti odnosi u postaji dovode do neočekivanih sukoba i još više kompliciraju stvar. Kako se žrtve gomilaju, a noćna tinejdžerska zabava na rijeci završi tragično, Endeavour zaključi da su u igri mračne sile koje događajima upravljaju na daljinu. programme.title: Sokol's eyes / Oči sokolove
programme.desc: Falcon eyes - (E06, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2024) The island of Pag. The unique island in the heart of Dalmatia is known for its harsh beauty, rich history and cultural heritage. Due to the storm worn with a resort, the surface of the whole Pag is irresistibly reminiscent of the surface of Mars, and Legend says that the ancient goddess Athens was on the island. On the island, we will get acquainted with the production of Pag lace, which is listed on the UNESCO list of the intangible heritage of humanity. Neda Oros will be told about the tradition of lace. The drone will also fly the north of the island of Pag, which also has gardens of centuries -old Luna olives. The wild olives are a symbol of resistance to storms and stone, and in one such corner of the Mediterranean there is a olive tree over 2000 years. In the midst of summer, the drone shots will also show the harvesting of a salt flower in the fields of Pag Solana. On the island of Pag, miles and kilometers of long drywall, the eternal monument of the heavy life of Pag aspiration, can be found, high enough that the Pag sheep cannot skip them. We will also follow the Ovcar Shepherd in the early morning tour of our herd. Pag is also rich in numerous archeological sites from various periods, among which the sites of ancient times are particularly emphasized. Air recordings will be accompanied by a group of underwater archaeologists that will clean an ancient ship from the 1st century BC in the area of ​​the Archaeological site near Simon. For the first time, testify to the performance of the Pag Tanca seen from the air. This dance, characteristic of its unique male and female costumes, reflects the tradition of this Adriatic jewel and the pride of all its inhabitants. The drone will also take us to the northeast coast of the Gulf of Pag, in a metajno, where we will see from the air what a trail looks like on the Mars field. That the bridges have always merged and that the symbols of the connections are, we will also be convinced by the air recordings of the Pag Bridge. This magnificent bow in the early morning with the sunrise will be reminded of the viewers to stop for a moment and see for a moment of unique beauty of this construction miracle. R.: Filip Filkovic ... / Oči sokolove - (E06, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2024) Otok Pag. Jedinstveni otok u srcu Dalmacije poznat je po svojoj surovoj ljepoti, bogatoj povijesti i kulturnoj baštini. Zbog bure nošene posolicom, površina cijelog Paga neodoljivo podsjeća na površinu Marsa, a legenda kaže kako je na otoku stolovala i antička božica Atena. Na otoku ćemo se upoznati s izradom paške čipke koja je uvrštena na Unescovu listu nematerijalne baštine čovječanstva. O tradiciji čipkarstva govorit će nam Neda Oros. Dron će preletjeti i sjever otoka Paga, na kojemu se nalaze i vrtovi stoljetnih lunskih maslina. Samonikle masline simbol su otpora prema buri i kamenu, a u jednom takvom kutku Mediterana smjestilo se i stablo masline staro više od 2000 godina. U jeku ljeta, snimke dronom prikazat će i berbu cvijeta soli na poljima paške solane. Na otoku Pagu mogu se pronaći kilometri i kilometri dugih suhozida, vječni spomenik teškog života paškog težaka, dovoljno visoki da ih paška ovca ne može preskočiti. Pratit ćemo i paškog ovčara u ranojutarnjem obilasku svojeg stada. Pag obiluje i mnogobrojnim arheološkim nalazištima iz raznih razdoblja, među kojima se posebno ističu nalazišta iz antičkog doba. Zračne snimke pratit će skupinu podvodnih arheologa koji će na području arheološkog nalazišta Letavica u blizini Šimuna čistiti antički brod iz 1. stoljeća prije Krista. Po prvi put posvjedočite i izvođenju paškog tanca viđenog iz zraka. Ovaj ples, karakterističan po svojim unikatnim muškim i ženskim nošnjama, odražava tradiciju ovog jadranskog dragulja i ponos svih njegovih stanovnika. programme.title: Istrian frescoes / Istarske freske
programme.desc: Istrian frescoes - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2017) Vesna Juric Rukavina's documentary, made with the help and support of the Diocese of Poreč and Pula, offers today's view of the past of one space and the fullness of life in it. The documentary is shown by a special Croatian gem at one time and creativity, which is much more than the painting of the space intended for the transfer of the Christian faith and the messages from the Old Testament and the New Testament. The scenes were shot in churches in Bale, God's Field, Vižinadi, Berm, Batvaca, Dvigrad, Kanfanar, Lovran, Hum, Roc, Draguć, Oprtalja, Lindar, Vodnjan, Poreč, Pula, Vol. Lovreč, Svetvincenat, Klostar above the sheet metal, Žminj and Peroj. In Istria, there are approximately 140 sites on which frescoes are located, from large and lavish to individual scenes and small fragments. The first frescoes in Istria were painted at the turn of 8th in the 9th century, while the golden age of the portrayal of sacral objects began in the 11th century and lasts until the 16th century. Indicators in the film are archaeologists and art historian Marino Baldini, conservator and art historian Željko Bistrovic, theologian and liturgical Milan Dancuo, archeologist and museologist Kristina Dzin, theologian Msgr. Marijan Jelinic, archaeologist Darko Komšo, art historian Sunčica Mustać and a licensed tourist guide for fresco Nikola Špehar. R .: Ivica Dlesk ... / Istarske freske - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2017) Dokumentarni film Vesne Jurić Rukavine, snimljen uz pomoć i potporu Porečke i pulske biskupije, kroz dvadesetak crkava pruža današnji pogled u prošlost jednoga prostora i puninu života u njemu. Dokumentarni film prikazuje poseban hrvatski dragulj jednoga vremena i stvaralaštva, koji je mnogo više od samoga oslikavanja prostora namijenjena prenošenju kršćanske vjere i poruka iz Staroga zavjeta i Novoga zavjeta. Prizori su snimljeni u crkvama u Balama, Božjemu polju, Vižinadi, Bermu, Batvačima, Dvigradu, Kanfanaru, Lovranu, Humu, Roču, Draguću, Oprtlju, Lindaru, Vodnjanu, Poreču, Puli, Sv. Lovreču, Svetvinčentu, Kloštru iznad Lima, Žminju i Peroju. U Istri postoji približno 140 lokaliteta na kojima se nalaze freske, od velikih i raskošnih do pojedinačnih scena i sitnih fragmenata. Prve freske u Istri naslikane su na prijelazu 8. u 9. stoljeće, dok zlatno doba oslikavanja sakralnih objekata počinje u 11. stoljeću i traje sve do 16. stoljeća. Kazivači u filmu su arheolog i povjesničar umjetnosti Marino Baldini, konzervator i povjesničar umjetnosti Željko Bistrović, teolog i liturgičar Milan Dančuo, arheologinja i muzeologinja Kristina Džin, teolog mons. Marijan Jelinić, arheolog Darko Komšo, povjesničarka umjetnosti Sunčica Mustać te licencirani turistički vodič za freske Nikola Špehar. R.: Ivica Dlesk...

programme.desc: Šibenik - 950 years - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2016) 2016, when the 950th anniversary of the first mention of the City of Šibenik, the Croatian Radio and Television for the Preservation of the Sibenik Heritage, Juraj Dalmatinac produced the documentary -based movie "Šibenik - 950 years" according to the screenplay and directed by Zoran Budak. Through the turbulent history of Šibenik, the viewers are conducted by the narrator, the Šibenik actor Mate Gulin, and fifty costumed extras were hired for the recording purposes. In 50 minutes, the history of the city is summed up through small paintings from city life and its most prominent residents. The cadres for the film were filmed at different locations of the city and its surroundings, at the Museum of the City of Šibenik, in Šibenik's fortresses, at the Cathedral of St. Jacob, and the film covers all the relevant life areas in which the people of Sibenik have left a mark over the centuries, such as science and art, urbanism, music and sports. The movie "Sibenik - 950 years" is a film account of the identity of Kresimir's city, in which many people from Sibenik's public life participate. Kroz burnu povijest Šibenika gledatelje vodi narator, šibenski glumac Mate Gulin, a za potrebe snimanja bilo je angažirano pedesetak kostimiranih statista. Jakova, a film pokriva sva relevantna životna područja u kojima su Šibenčani tijekom stoljeća ostavili trag, poput znanosti i umjetnosti, urbanizma, glazbe i sporta. And now for ten years he has lived and worked in England and the life of a young married couple in that country is the theme of her new novel between ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Danas kada se susrećemo sa stalno novim migrantima, Robert Perišić podsjetio nas je da je i naša civilizacija posljedica nekih davnih migracija. programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia) Shakespeare's classic Romeo and Juliet, like his Hamlet, is an eternal inspiration to many diverse artistic reflections. Thus, the great opera composer Vincenzo Bellini wrote an opera in whose focus he put a conflict between two Veron families and called Capuleta and Montecchi. His opera version of Shakespeare's drama is rarely found on the repertoire because there are no known arias and is very difficult to perform, but this masterpiece is still full of wonderful topics and choral scenes. Therefore, it deserves to be enjoyed by the audience of our time, especially in Split, as a rule, a reluctant early Belkant. On the trail of extension of repertoire views, the title was placed in the program of the season of the Croatian National Theater there by the director of Split Opera Ivan Srbljan. For the conductor of reprise performances and assistant Maestro Ivo Lipanovic, who was preparing the premiere, she chose the best placed Croatian competitor at the conductor of the conductor of Lovro von Matacic, the choir of the Kojdija City Theater, Davor Kelic. The directorial job entrusted to the young and increasingly promising Hrvoje Korbar, to whom this is the second independent opera directing after last year Gotovac's one -piece Stanac in Zagreb. His closest associates are in this production of sculptor and set designer Zdravko Ivandi Kirigin, and painter and costume designer Barbara Bourek who opted for abstract design of historical sources. The crew of the class of classics arrives in Split at the last performance of the season, March 5, 2024, and deals with the compliant division consisting of domestic and guests: Split mezzo -soprano Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), Slovenian soprano Nina Dominko (Julija), Split Bariton Josko Tranfić (Lorenzo), Sinjski bass, Sam Furnes (Tebaldo). The small but powerful team gave her best to present this opera at the best. We recorded their thoughts on the subject ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Shakespeareov klasik Romeo i Julija, poput njegova Hamleta, vječna je inspiracija mnogim raznolikim umjetničkim promišljanjima. Tako je veliki operni skladatelj Vincenzo Bellini napisao operu u čiji je fokus stavio sukob dviju veronskih obitelji, te djelo nazvao Capuleti i Montecchi. Njegova se operna verzija Shakespeareove drame rijetko nalazi na repertoaru jer nema poznatih arija i vrlo je teška za izvođenje, no ovo remek-djelo ipak vrvi predivnim temama i zborskim prizorima. Stoga u njemu zaslužuje uživati i publika našeg doba, poglavito u Splitu, u pravilu nesklonom ranom belkantu. Na tragu proširenja repertoarnih vidika naslov je u program sezone tamošnjega Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta smjestila ravnateljica Splitske opere Ivana Srbljan. Za dirigenta repriznih predstava i asistenta maestru Ivi Lipanoviću, koji je pripremao premijeru, odabrala je najbolje plasiranog hrvatskog natjecatelja na dirigentskom natjecanju Lovro von Matačić, inače zborovođu Gradskog kazališta Komedija, Davora Kelića. Redateljski je posao povjerila mladom i sve perspektivnijem Hrvoju Korbaru kojemu je ovo druga samostalna operna režija nakon prošloljetne Gotovčeve jednočinke Stanac u Zagrebu. Njegove su najbliskije suradnice u ovoj produkciji kiparica i scenografkinja Zdravka Ivandija Kirigin, te slikarica i kostimografkinja Barbara Bourek koje su se odlučile za apstraktno oblikovanje povijesnih izvora. Ekipa Svijeta klasike stiže u Split na posljednju predstavu u sezoni, 5. ožujka 2024., te zatiče usklađenu podjelu koju čine domaći i gosti: splitska mezzosopranistica Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), slovenska sopranistica Nina Dominko (Julija), splitski bariton Joško Tranfić (Lorenzo), sinjski bas Božo Župić (Capellio), te velški tenor Sam Furness (Tebaldo). Mala, ali moćna ekipa dala je sve od sebe predstaviti ovu operu u najboljem izdanju. Zabilježili smo njihova razmišljanja na tu temu...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) What makes the life of jazz and jazzists specific in relation to other genres is the amount of importance to encounter new musicians, playing exchange with colleagues you have not had the opportunity to play with before. One such form was presented to us at the end of May 2024. Our Istrian jazz-shot: trumpeter Branko Sterpin, double bass player Vedran Ruzic and drummer Marco Quarantotto, joined by fantastic Slovenian pianist Marko Crncec, all with the aim of hosting the stars of the world jazz in Pula Zenona. The concert of this commemorative quintet, realized on Sterpin's initiative as part of the Jazz Waves program, was also important as an incentive for our musicians, who deserve to gain visibility through such collaborations. programme.title: The world of classics / Svijet klasike
programme.desc: Classic World - (Music. A show, Croatia) Shakespeare's classic Romeo and Juliet, like his Hamlet, is an eternal inspiration to many diverse artistic reflections. Thus, the great opera composer Vincenzo Bellini wrote an opera in whose focus he put a conflict between two Veron families and called Capuleta and Montecchi. His opera version of Shakespeare's drama is rarely found on the repertoire because there are no known arias and is very difficult to perform, but this masterpiece is still full of wonderful topics and choral scenes. Therefore, it deserves to be enjoyed by the audience of our time, especially in Split, as a rule, a reluctant early Belkant. On the trail of extension of repertoire views, the title was placed in the program of the season of the Croatian National Theater there by the director of Split Opera Ivan Srbljan. For the conductor of reprise performances and assistant Maestro Ivo Lipanovic, who was preparing the premiere, she chose the best placed Croatian competitor at the conductor of the conductor of Lovro von Matacic, the choir of the Kojdija City Theater, Davor Kelic. The directorial job entrusted to the young and increasingly promising Hrvoje Korbar, to whom this is the second independent opera directing after last year Gotovac's one -piece Stanac in Zagreb. His closest associates are in this production of sculptor and set designer Zdravko Ivandi Kirigin, and painter and costume designer Barbara Bourek who opted for abstract design of historical sources. The crew of the class of classics arrives in Split at the last performance of the season, March 5, 2024, and deals with the compliant division consisting of domestic and guests: Split mezzo -soprano Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), Slovenian soprano Nina Dominko (Julija), Split Bariton Josko Tranfić (Lorenzo), Sinjski bass, Sam Furnes (Tebaldo). The small but powerful team gave her best to present this opera at the best. We recorded their thoughts on the subject ... / Svijet klasike - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska) Shakespeareov klasik Romeo i Julija, poput njegova Hamleta, vječna je inspiracija mnogim raznolikim umjetničkim promišljanjima. Tako je veliki operni skladatelj Vincenzo Bellini napisao operu u čiji je fokus stavio sukob dviju veronskih obitelji, te djelo nazvao Capuleti i Montecchi. Njegova se operna verzija Shakespeareove drame rijetko nalazi na repertoaru jer nema poznatih arija i vrlo je teška za izvođenje, no ovo remek-djelo ipak vrvi predivnim temama i zborskim prizorima. Stoga u njemu zaslužuje uživati i publika našeg doba, poglavito u Splitu, u pravilu nesklonom ranom belkantu. Na tragu proširenja repertoarnih vidika naslov je u program sezone tamošnjega Hrvatskog narodnog kazališta smjestila ravnateljica Splitske opere Ivana Srbljan. Za dirigenta repriznih predstava i asistenta maestru Ivi Lipanoviću, koji je pripremao premijeru, odabrala je najbolje plasiranog hrvatskog natjecatelja na dirigentskom natjecanju Lovro von Matačić, inače zborovođu Gradskog kazališta Komedija, Davora Kelića. Redateljski je posao povjerila mladom i sve perspektivnijem Hrvoju Korbaru kojemu je ovo druga samostalna operna režija nakon prošloljetne Gotovčeve jednočinke Stanac u Zagrebu. Njegove su najbliskije suradnice u ovoj produkciji kiparica i scenografkinja Zdravka Ivandija Kirigin, te slikarica i kostimografkinja Barbara Bourek koje su se odlučile za apstraktno oblikovanje povijesnih izvora. Ekipa Svijeta klasike stiže u Split na posljednju predstavu u sezoni, 5. ožujka 2024., te zatiče usklađenu podjelu koju čine domaći i gosti: splitska mezzosopranistica Bjanka Ivas (Romeo), slovenska sopranistica Nina Dominko (Julija), splitski bariton Joško Tranfić (Lorenzo), sinjski bas Božo Župić (Capellio), te velški tenor Sam Furness (Tebaldo). Mala, ali moćna ekipa dala je sve od sebe predstaviti ovu operu u najboljem izdanju. Zabilježili smo njihova razmišljanja na tu temu...

programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Today, when we meet with constant new migrants, Robert Perisic reminded us that our civilization is also a consequence of some of the ancient migration. The novel The Issu ship brought us back to the 4th century before our era, in an era where the Illyrians did not want to drink wine brought by the Greeks, as an act of a kind of resistance to the then globalization, while the Greeks of beer considered Barbari. Our guest is Robert Perisic. Kristina Gavran was born in Zagreb and at the last year of dramaturgy studies gets an Erasmus scholarship and goes to professional practice in Birmingham. And now for ten years he has lived and worked in England and the life of a young married couple in that country is the theme of her new novel between ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Danas kada se susrećemo sa stalno novim migrantima, Robert Perišić podsjetio nas je da je i naša civilizacija posljedica nekih davnih migracija. Naš je gost Robert Perišić. Kristina Gavran rođena je u Zagrebu a na posljednjoj godini studija dramaturgije dobiva Erasmus stipendiju i odlazi na stručnu praksu u Birmingham. I sada već desetak godina živi i radi u Engleskoj a život mladog bračnog para u toj zemlji tema je njezinog novog romana Između...

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2016) Can the camera take a difference between the acting and real closeness of two people? How to monitor the growing up of nephews by recording his psychological states and resistance to educational methods? Is it hiding behind a "family exercise" a humorous departure from everyday routine or exploring new relationships within the family? To these questions, Petra is a slim answer - photos. programme.title: What is a classic? / Što je klasik?
programme.desc: What is a classic? - (Cult. Magazine, Croatia) Behind the unusual poetry of Joseph North, there is also an unusual life path. They proclaimed him a blasphemy, a top dreamer of everyday life, a priest of sound and rhythm, a don kihot who rides on a ridge of books. He was the last true bohemian of Croatian literature. He searched for the magic of the language in the verses, and for the passion he publicly performed with, he was called a poetic shaman. The poet who has brought a whole new experience in Croatian poetry, according to stylistics professor, poet and critic, academician Kresimir Bagic and one of his closest friends, writer Ludwig Bauer. R.: Ivo Kuzmanic ... / Što je klasik? - (kult. magazin, Hrvatska) Iza nesvakidašnje poezije Josipa Severa krije se i nesvakidašnji životni put. Proglasili su ga bogotražiteljem, vrhunskim sanjačem svakodnevice, svećenikom zvuka i ritma, Don Kihotom koji jaše na hrptu knjiga. Bio je posljednji istinski boem hrvatske književnosti. U stihovima tragao je za magijom jezika, a zbog strasti s kojom ih je javno izvodio prozvan je poetskim šamanom. O pjesniku koji je donio posve novo iskustvo u hrvatsku poeziju, govore profesor stilistike, pjesnik i kritičar, akademik Krešimir Bagić i jedan od njegovih najbližih prijatelja pisac Ludwig Bauer. R.: Ivo Kuzmanić...

For human rights in Strasbourg, on the election process for the president of the Supreme Court, how much did it help or fired from the law mile, about moral dilemmas in criminal cases, and the future of lawyer and judiciary in the context of an increasing effect of artificial intelligence. Fran Olujic was born in Zagreb on May 5, 1977 in the family of his mother's architect and father, a well -known lawyer and the first Attorney General. After graduating from the XVI, he enrolled in the Faculty of Law, at which he graduated in 2003. He passed the judicial exam in 2005, and in 2006 he was entered in the directory of the lawyer of the Croatian Bar Association. He is the owner of a law firm who deals with civil, trade law and employs a dozen lawyers and law trainees. In the last 15 years, there was almost no major and more important criminal case in which he had not been hired. The current judicial and social issues do not publicly comment on, and, thanks to Insijder, insight and professional knowledge, is a common and respected interlocutor in the media. He speaks English, German and Italian. He lives in Zagreb with his wife and three ... / Romano Bolković - 1 na 1 - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) S odvjetnikom Franom Olujićem razgovaramo o trenutačnom stanju hrvatskog pravosuđa i načinu na koji ga percipira šira javnost, o tome koliko smo udaljeni od ideala vladavine prava s obzirom da državu vode pravnici, je li činjenica da je profesor prava bio Predsjednik RH išta promijenila, o tome koji je najveći problem hrvatskog pravosuđa danas, ima li pomaka nabolje u našem pravosuđu, o problemima u obrazovanju budućih pravnika i njihovoj pripremi za praktičan rad, o korupciji i organiziranom kriminalu, zašto složeni sudski postupci u RH traju godinama, o curenju informacija iz istraga u javnost i medijskoj pripremi predmeta, o izravnom i neizravnom političkom utjecaju na sudove i Državno odvjetništvo, o radu glavnog državnog odvjetnika, o ulozi EPPO-a, Europskog suda pravde i Europskog suda za ljudska prava u Strasbourgu, o izbornom procesu za predsjednika Vrhovnog suda, koliko mu je je to što je iz odvjetničkog miljea pomoglo ili odmoglo, o moralnim dilemama u kaznenim predmetima te o budućnosti odvjetništva i pravosuđa u kontekstu sve većeg utjecaja umjetne inteligencije. Fran Olujić rođen je u Zagrebu 5. svibnja 1977. u obitelji majke arhitektice i oca, poznatog odvjetnika te prvog glavnog državnog odvjetnika. Nakon završetka XVI. jezične gimnazije upisuje Pravni fakultet, na kojem je diplomirao 2003. godine. Pravosudni ispit položio je 2005., a 2006. godine upisuje se u Imenik odvjetnika Hrvatske odvjetničke komore. Vlasnik je odvjetničkog društva koje se bavi građanskim, trgovačkim i kaznenim pravom te zapošljava desetak odvjetnika i odvjetničkih vježbenika. U posljednjih 15 godina gotovo da nije bilo većeg i važnijeg kaznenog predmeta u kojem nije bio angažiran. Ne libi se javno komentirati aktualna pravosudna i društvena pitanja te je, zahvaljujući insajderskom uvidu i stručnom znanju, čest i cijenjen sugovornik u medijima. programme.title: Minority mosaic / Manjinski mozaik
programme.desc: Minority mosaic - (educational film, Croatia) danced once. They still dance today. They bridged all those good, but also lead years on Kordun, dance. Many generations of young Serbs, Croats and Bosniaks are proud to say that they have learned the first steps in the ensemble of folk games and songs Vojnic. And it's not just folklore. This is above all and above all a school of life for many young people. The leader of the Cedomir Studen ensemble points out that the mission of the ensemble is to build healthy intermediate relationships. Dancing its own and dances from other parts, it enriches its own culture and builds a wider view of the world ... / Manjinski mozaik - (obrazovni film, Hrvatska) Plesali su nekad. Plešu i danas. Plesom su premostili sve one dobre, ali i olovne godine kojih je na Kordunu uvijek bilo. Mnoge generacije mladih Srba, Hrvata i Bošnjaka s ponosom kažu da su prve korake naučili u Ansamblu narodnih igara i pjesama Vojnić. I nije to samo folklor. To je iznad svega i prije svega škola života za mnoge mlade. Voditelj Ansambla Čedomir Studen ističe da je misija Ansambla izgraditi zdrave međunacionalne odnose. Plešući svoje i plesove iz drugih krajeva, obogaćuje se vlastita kultura i izgrađuje širi pogled na svijet...

programme.title: My mom / أمي
programme.desc: Basma lives in a house that is shrouded in violence and neglect because of her mother's husband, Obaid, who suffers from a smile of ill -treatment and lack of safety, which makes her life full of fear and loneliness. Her teacher, Maryam, hinted silent signs of Basma's suffering, so she decided to intervene to save her from this difficult situation. Mary creates a strong relationship with Basma, and fights alongside her to free her from the circle of pain and violence, which makes a major shift in the child's life and gives her hope for a better future. / تعيش الطفلة بسمة في منزل يكتنفه العنف والإهمال بسبب زوج والدتها عبيد، تعاني بسمة من سوء المعاملة وقلة الأمان، مما يجعل حياتها مليئة بالخوف والوحدة. تلمح معلمتها مريم، علامات صامتة على معاناة بسمة، فتقرر التدخل لإنقاذها من هذا الوضع الصعب. تنشئ مريم علاقة قوية مع بسمة، وتكافح إلى جانبها لتحريرها من دائرة الألم والعنف، مما يحدث تحولًا كبيرًا في حياة الطفلة ويمنحها الأمل في مستقبل أفضل.

programme.title: Wild Heart S2 / Wild Heart S2
programme.desc: In the second season, after the meeting of all family members under one roof, (Yaman) reveals the real intentions (Sarhan), and faces a dangerous opponent, and he seeks to secure the future of his loved ones. / في الموسم الثاني وبعد اجتماع جميع أفراد العائلة تحت سقف واحد، يكشف (يامان) نوايا (سرحان) الحقيقية، ويواجه خصما خطيرا، فيسعى لتأمين مستقبل أحبائه.

programme.title: Birth certificate / شهادة ميلاد
programme.desc: A mother is struggling with various means to preserve her family from disintegration, after the death of the father, but facts from the distant past are revealed to fluctuate the scales and fail all plans, and warns of a fateful future. / تجاهد أم بشتى الوسائل للحفاظ على عائلتها من التفكك وذلك بعد وفاة الأب، لكن حقائق من الماضي البعيد تتكشف لتقلب الموازين وتفشل كل الخطط، وتنذر بمستقبل مشؤوم.

programme.title: Why not?! 3 / ليه لأ؟! 3
programme.desc: The events revolve around (Sherry), a divorced mother with a special relationship with her son (Yassin), but when she falls in love again, Yassin's jealousy forms an obstacle that they must overlook together. / تدور الأحداث حول (شيري)، وهي أم مطلقة تتمتع بعلاقة خاصة مع ابنها (ياسين)، ولكن عندما تقع في الحب من جديد، تشكل غيرة (ياسين) عليها عقبة يتوجب عليهما تجاوزها سويًا.

programme.title: My Name Is Farah / My Name Is Farah
programme.desc: Farah works illegally cleaning in Istanbul after escaping from Iran, then she tries to travel to France and take care of her young son, but her life turns upside down when she witnesses a murder in her workplace, then she tries to escape from the perpetrators of the crime after getting to know her. / تعمل (فرح) عاملة نظافة بشكل غير قانوني في إسطنبول بعد فرارها من إيران، ثم تحاول السفر إلى فرنسا والاعتناء بابنها الصغير، لكن تنقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب عندما تشهد جريمة قتل في مكان عملها، ثم تحاول الهرب من مرتكبي الجريمة بعد تعرفهم عليها.
